review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the definitions of xOverZ and yOverZ in Def_WeierstrassCurve_PointChart. The only repeated machinery I judged substantial enough to report is awayMk_X and awayMk_Y. The two parallel blocks in isSectionThrough_act (hcx/hcy and hH0/hH1) and the repeated `opensRange_awayι` rewrite in zchart_core are short and specialised, so I did not report them. The proposed lemmas are untested. I did not check whether Mathlib already has an additivity lemma for Away.mk, and the exact simp/ring closing steps would need adjusting when compiling.

findings.problem: The two lemmas have the same proof skeleton. Each does `subst hn`, then `val_injective`, then a simp unfolding of `Away.val_mk`, then rewrites with Localization.mk_mul, add_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff and r_iff_exists. It closes with `refine ⟨1, ?_⟩`, a simp only with the same lemma list, and `ring`. awayMk_Y only adds one more mk_mul and add_mk. Each lemma re-derives the same fact at the Localization level: the degree-1 Away element of a linear form in the coordinates is the corresponding sum of `scal` coefficients times `xOverZ`, `yOverZ` or 1. A third coordinate form would need a third copy.
findings.proposed_change: Prove two general facts about `Away.mk _ (coord_mem W 2) 1`, once each. (1) Additivity: for n m in degree 1, `Away.mk .. 1 (n+m) _ = Away.mk .. 1 n _ + Away.mk .. 1 m _`. (2) Scalar pull-out: for q = cls (X i) in degree 1, `Away.mk .. 1 (cls (C a * X i)) _ = scal W a * Away.mk .. 1 (cls (X i)) _`. Prove the scalar fact with one val_injective, Localization.mk_mul and mk_eq_mk_iff argument. Special-case i = 2 so that `Away.mk .. 1 (cls (C a * X 2)) _ = scal W a`, since X 2 / Z = 1. Then awayMk_X and awayMk_Y become `rw` or `simp` chains: split `cls (C u2 * X 0 + C r * X 2)` with `map_add`, then apply the scalar lemma, with `xOverZ`/`yOverZ` unfolded to `Away.mk .. (coord W i)`. Neither lemma then needs its own Localization.r_iff_exists/ring block, and the `ring` side goals disappear.
findings.benefit: The Localization-level cross-multiplication is argued once instead of twice, and adding another chart-coordinate formula costs a few rewrites. The lemma statements stay the same, so `hH0` and `hH1` at lines ~228-233 (`awayMk_X (vc • W) _ _ _ hVC.2.1 _`, `awayMk_Y ...`) are unaffected.
